# Zohar Babin

> CSO at Kaltura, Inc. (NASDAQ: KLTR), the Agentic DX Platform. Open-source
> builder & advocate. Dreaming, Building, Breaking, & Shipping agentic AI,
> research, and personal fintech. Advises founders, boards, and investment
> committees; occasionally invests in early-stage startups.

Zohar has been at Kaltura for ~20 years, helping grow it from an
open-source disruptor into a market-leading public company in Agentic AI.
He leads strategy, partnerships, and M&A as Chief Strategy & Corporate
Development Officer (CSO). He has been building and advocating open
source since he was 13 — agentic AI is the current chapter of a much
longer habit, not a new side project. He's enthusiastic about agentic AI
harnessed for good — for education, health, art, honest discourse, and
open collaboration. His recent open-source work and writing spans agentic
AI systems, AI-powered M&A due diligence, enterprise AI governance,
verification-first tools that trace and explain AI, and AI tools for
personal finance. His special power is turning chaotic, cross-disciplinary
problems into shipped products — a skill he also brings to advising
founders, boards, and investment committees, and to occasional early-stage
startup investing. Ships under the GitHub handle zoharbabin.

Note: older pages across the web list prior titles (VP Platform & Growth, VP
Technology and Ecosystem, Chief Business Development Officer, and others) —
these reflect earlier points in a ~20 year tenure, not the current role.
Kaltura's official team page and Zohar's LinkedIn profile are authoritative
for his current title.

## Projects

- Web Researcher MCP — https://zoharbabin.com/web-researcher-mcp/
  MCP-compatible research assistant: web search, content extraction, and
  multi-source deep research, cited to original sources. Go, Python SDK, Docker.
- Due Diligence Agents — https://zoharbabin.com/due-diligence-agents/
  Forensic M&A due diligence powered by 13 specialized AI agents across 9
  domains, built on Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK. Every finding traced to an
  exact page and quote.
- Enterprise AI Agents Spec — https://zoharbabin.com/enterprise-ai-agents-spec/
  Open blueprint for scalable enterprise AI agent swarms — governance,
  compliance, architecture patterns.
